grid.subject: Subject
grid.undoSuccess: The last grade save was undone.
grid.rejected: {{count}} grade entries could not be saved.

grid.noOwner: No owner is assigned. Contact an administrator.

grid.ownershipWarningTitle: These changes are outside your assignment

grid.bulkClass: Set ratings for the whole class
grid.bulkStudentHint: Applies to all {{count}} rating assessments for this student.
grid.bulkClassHint: Applies to all {{count}} rating assessments for each of the {{students}} students in this subject.
grid.bulkSaveHint: Includes every category. Changes are saved when you press Save.
grid.noTeacherNotes: No teacher notes field is configured for this subject. An administrator can add a text field under Columns.
grid.compactDraftAccess: Saving another teacher’s fields requires confirmation and is recorded in the audit trail.

classWorkspace.sortHint: Students are automatically sorted by school number.

classWorkspace.gradeEntryInTeacher: Grades are entered in the teacher table.
classWorkspace.dragHint: Drag a student by the handle onto another class tab. Their identity, language, grades, and notes move with them.
classWorkspace.removeStudentsHint: Remove students from {{className}} for the selected school year. Their student records and saved grades are retained.

assignmentBoard.classTrayHint: Drag a class into a teacher field.

lifecycle.description: Run year and semester transitions explicitly.

lifecycle.setupReady: This year is ready to activate.
lifecycle.missingNumbers: Assign school numbers to {{count}} students in the class tables before activation.

lifecycle.actionFailed: That transition could not be completed. Check the readiness message and try again.
lifecycle.storedAudit: I stored the downloaded audit export.
lifecycle.archiveSafety: First download and safely store the audit export. You will confirm the academic year in the next step.
lifecycle.auditReady: Audit export downloaded. Confirm storage to continue.
